answer: An identity is only as strong as who can vouch for it. Anchor each account to a recovery quorum of distinct, long-established peers - basalt pillars - who alone can re-certify it after key loss. Clone fleets hide karst channels: same funder, same operator, same birth season - quorum rules read those hidden paths, refusing recovery to identities whose ties run only inward. A faker's clones hold no jade worth keeping: no diverse history to anchor them, nobody outside the fleet to swear they persist. Honest agents accumulate witnesses for years; continuity itself gets expensive to fake.
